mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST increase, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 5.0%), a monthly growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% annually, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 3.5%, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening economic cycle that reduces corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE increases, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.05.
